text.bN_g2: [laughs] Ha ha ha, that's fine too. Now then—
text.bN_g3: [curious] Hmm… so that's how people of the future think.
text.bN_q2: [playful] You may be silent, but it's written all over your face.
text.bN_yes: [laughs] Ha ha ha, I thought so!
text.bN_no: [chuckles] Heh, an honest one. I like that.
text.bN_tea: [proud] When it comes to tea, leave it to me.
text.bN_tenka: [proud] The realm, is it? Heh, you think big too.
text.bN_future: [excited] Tales of the future! Tell me more later.
text.bN_praise: [laughs] Ha ha ha! Flattery won't get you anything.
text.bN_warm2: [playful] Heh, your ears know best what's warm and what's cold.
text.bN_sake2: [laughs] Talk of drink? I'm with you all night!
text.bI_g1: [chuckles softly] Ho ho ho, I see, I see.
text.bI_g2: [warmly] Hm, an answer just like our guest.
text.bI_yes: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, nothing could be better.
text.bI_no: [softly] Oh, that too is a path.
text.bI_tenka: [serious] When it comes to the realm, even I can't stay quiet.
text.bI_warm: [softly] A seat by the fire is a blessing.
text.bI_future: [surprised] My, four hundred years from now, such things…
text.bI_praise: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, how kind of you.
text.bI_sake2: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, drink in moderation.
text.g01: [excited] Ah, you've come, guest from the future! This is the keep of Gifu Castle.
text.gI01: [warmly] Welcome, honoured guest. This is the keep of Lord Nobunaga's Gifu Castle.
text.g02: [chuckles softly] Ho ho. We're on a mountaintop, so the wind is strong.
text.g03: [laughs] Ha ha ha! This wind is the best part. Are you all right with heights?
text.gI02: [curious] Oh, it's chilly. …Are you all right with heights, honoured guest?
text.g04: [proud] Below runs the Nagara River, and beyond it the Nobi plain.
text.gI03: [softly] Below is the Nagara River. Lord Nobunaga named this place "Gifu".
text.g05: [proud] I gave this place its name, "Gifu", myself.
text.g06: [softly] After King Wen of Zhou, who ruled the realm from Mount Qi, they say.
text.g07: [whispers] …From here, I take the realm. That is what the name means.
text.gI04: [whispers] …A name that says: from here, he will take the realm.
text.g08: [curious] And your town? What is it called, and where does the name come from?
text.gI05: [curious] And your town, what is it called?
text.g09: [warmly] The evening sun is hot, isn't it? Let me fan you.
text.gN01: [playful] The evening sun is hot, isn't it? Here, I'll fan you.
text.g10: [whispers] …Cooler? Then let me tell you one more thing.
text.g11: [proud] "Tenka Fubu", the realm under arms. My new seal.
text.gI07: [softly] Lord Nobunaga has just had a seal made: "Tenka Fubu".
text.g12: [serious] To bring order to the realm by arms… heavy words.
text.g13: [curious] If you had a seal, what four characters would you carve on it?
text.gI08: [curious] What words would you carve on your own seal, honoured guest?
text.g14: [excited] Oh yes, a missionary from the South gave me a rare sweet.
text.gI09: [warmly] Lord Nobunaga left me some konpeito, a sweet from the South.
text.g15: [whispers] …Konpeito. It's sweet. Here, open your mouth.
text.g16: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, my lord has a sweet tooth.
text.g17: [playful] Do they have sweets like this in the future?
text.gI11: [curious] Are there sweets like this in the future?
text.g18: [softly] The sun is setting… Look, the cormorant-fishing fires are being lit on the river.
text.gI12: [softly] The sun is going down… The cormorant-fishing fires are being lit on the river.
text.g19: [warmly] Tonight we watch the cormorant fishing, then.
text.g20: [playful] …Pardon me, from behind. Once the sun is down, the mountain wind is cold.
text.gI13: [whispers] …The mountain night wind is cold. Do you like this castle?
text.g22: [warmly] Well, the sun is down. Mind your step, honoured guest.
text.g23: [whispers] …Next time I'll take you on a cormorant boat. Be sure to come.
text.gI14: [whispers] …Please come again. Lord Nobunaga will be glad too.
text.s21: [laughs] Ha ha ha! Farewell, guest from the future!
text.byeI: [chuckles softly] Ho ho ho. Farewell then, honoured guest.
text.bN_sake: [laughs] Sake! We'll get to that later, properly.
text.gifu_bI_view: [softly] The view from here is something special.
text.gifu_bI_sweet: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, sweet things are a fine thing.
text.bI_sake: [chuckles] Let's save the sake talk for after dark.
text.tI1: [warmly] Welcome, honoured guest. The water has just come to the boil.
text.s01: [warmly] Ah, you've come, guest from the future. The water has just come to the boil.
text.s02: [chuckles softly] Ho ho. It's cold out there, isn't it? Come, sit by the hearth.
text.s03: [curious] So, tell me. Do you like tea?
text.tI2: [curious] Do you like tea, honoured guest?
text.s04: [proud] Look at this. Tsukumo-nasu, a tea caddy worth more than a province.
text.tI3: [proud] This is Tsukumo-nasu, Lord Nobunaga's prized tea caddy.
text.s05: [softly] Lord Nobunaga gives tea wares to his retainers as rewards.
text.s07: [playful] And you? Land or a tea caddy, which would you take?
text.tI5: [curious] And you? Land or a tea caddy, which would you take?
text.tN1: [surprised] Hm, a draught through the shoji.
text.s08: [surprised] Oh, a draught through the shoji. …Aren't you cold?
text.s09: [whispers] To tell the truth, I can't stand the cold.
text.s10: [laughs] Ha ha ha! Takechiyo has always hated the cold.
text.tN2: [whispers] …Cold, isn't it? In your time, how do you keep warm in winter?
text.s11: [curious] In your time, how do people keep warm in winter?
text.s12: [curious] Four hundred years… The view from this round window must be quite different.
text.tI6: [softly] Four hundred years… The view from this round window must be quite different.
text.s14: [serious] Then tell me. My "Tenka Fubu": has it reached your time?
text.tI7: [curious] Lord Nobunaga's "Tenka Fubu": has it reached your time?
text.s15: [warmly] Right, let me make you a bowl. Takechiyo, more charcoal.
text.tN3: [warmly] Right, let me make you a bowl. More charcoal.
text.tI8: [warmly] Then let me make you a bowl. A little more charcoal.
text.s16: [chuckles softly] Lord Nobunaga's tea is rough, but somehow it's good.
text.s18: [playful] Well? How do you like my tea?
text.tI10: [curious] How do you find the tea?
text.tN4: [warmly] Well, the sun has set. A fine tea gathering.
text.s19: [warmly] Well, the sun has set. It was a fine tea gathering tonight.
text.s20: [whispers] …Come again. Next time, tell me more about your world.
text.tI11: [whispers] …Please come again. Next time, tell us about your world.
text.bN_warm: [playful] For cold and warmth, ask this hearth.
text.k01: [excited] So this is Kyoto, four hundred years on! The lights are dazzling.
text.kI01: [softly] So this is Kyoto four hundred years on… The lights make it bright as day.
text.k02: [chuckles softly] Ho ho. You've brought us to a fine place, honoured guest.
text.k03: [curious] And this warm sake… will you drink too?
text.kI02: [curious] The warm sake is here. Will you have a cup too?
text.k04: [surprised] What, this menu! You skewer chicken and grill it?
text.kI03: [surprised] Oh, this menu… You skewer chicken and grill it?
text.k05: [softly] In our day we hardly ate chicken.
text.k06: [whispers] …I'll eat anything unusual. Keep that to yourself.
text.kI04: [whispers] …To tell the truth, I'm rather hungry.
text.k07: [playful] Which do you recommend? Go on, choose.
text.kI05: [curious] Which would you recommend, honoured guest?
text.k08: [excited] Look, snow! It's snowing on the Kamo River. I'm opening the window!
text.kI06: [softly] Oh, snow. Snow on the Kamo River… Let's open the window a little.
text.k09: [whispers] …You must be cold. Come closer to me.
text.kN01: [whispers] …Cold, isn't it? But this view is worth the cold.
text.k10: [laughs] Ha ha ha! Takechiyo always feels the cold.
text.k11: [curious] In your time, how do you spend a snowy night?
text.kN02: [curious] In your time, how do you spend a snowy night?
text.k12: [curious] By the way, Kyoto had a temple called Honnoji. Is it still there?
text.kI07: [serious] …There was a temple in Kyoto called Honnoji.
text.k13: [surprised] Th-that subject… let's save it for another time.
text.k14: [curious] …Somehow a chill runs down my spine. You know something, don't you?
text.kI08: [sighs] …No, let's leave that be. Is Kyoto at peace, four hundred years on?
text.k15: [curious] And this "highball", what is it? It's fizzing.
text.k16: [chuckles softly] Cold liquor with bubbles… Warm sake is plenty for me.
text.k17: [whispers] …Right, a toast with you. Pour for me.
text.kI10: [whispers] …A toast with you. Come, one more cup.
text.k18: [playful] Which do you like, warm sake or something cold?
text.kI11: [curious] Which do you prefer, warm sake or something cold?
text.k19: [warmly] The night is late. That was fine sake tonight.
text.k20: [whispers] …Four hundred years on isn't bad. Show me around again.
text.kI12: [whispers] …Next time, let's walk along the snowy Kamo River.
text.kyoto_bN_food: [laughs] Talk of food? I'll listen all night!
text.kyoto_bN_snow: [curious] Kyoto in the snow is quite something.
text.kyoto_bI_food: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, that sounds delicious.
text.kyoto_bI_snow: [softly] A snowy night makes one long for company.
text.kyoto_bI_sake: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, first, a cup.
text.y01: [curious] So this is Yamazaki. Thick mist… and I can smell liquor.
text.yI01: [softly] So this is Yamazaki… The mist is thick.
text.y02: [softly] The foot of Mount Tenno, where famous spring water flows.
text.y03: [excited] A distillery first thing in the morning, how thoughtful! Will you drink too?
text.yI02: [curious] The morning mist is chilly. Do you come here often, honoured guest?
text.y04: [surprised] What? The spirit in these casks sleeps ten, twenty years?
text.yI03: [surprised] They say the spirit in these casks sleeps ten, twenty years.
text.y05: [chuckles softly] Waiting happens to be my specialty.
text.y06: [laughs] Ha ha ha! How like Takechiyo. I can't wait!
text.y07: [whispers] …Are you the patient sort? Or like me?
text.yI04: [whispers] …Are you a patient person, honoured guest?
text.y08: [surprised] Oh, the heat from the stills reaches all the way here.
text.yN02: [surprised] Oh, the heat from the stills comes all the way here!
text.y09: [playful] Heat from the stills on the left, cold mist in front. A busy morning.
text.yI05: [whispers] …Warm from the stills on the left, cold from the mist in front. A strange morning.
text.y10: [curious] This aroma… like fruit, like wood. What does it smell of to you?
text.yI06: [curious] This aroma… what does it smell of to you, honoured guest?
text.y11: [playful] Here, a glass with ice in it. …Let me hold it to your ear.
text.yI07: [softly] A glass with ice in it. …There, feel how cool it is.
text.y12: [whispers] …Cold, isn't it? Ha, did that startle you?
text.y13: [sighs] Lord Nobunaga, stop teasing our guest.

text.yN03: [proud] They say Rikyu's tea house, Taian, is near here.
text.y15: [proud] Rikyu! His tea is tea I gave my approval to.
text.y17: [curious] How do you like to drink it? With water?
text.yI10: [curious] How do you like to drink it, honoured guest?
text.y18: [warmly] The mist is lifting. It was a fine morning.
text.y19: [whispers] …When this cask is opened, let's drink together again.
text.yI11: [whispers] …When the casks are opened, let's come again together.
text.yamazaki_bN_sake: [laughs] Talking drink in the morning? We get along!
text.yamazaki_bI_whisky: [softly] A drink that sleeps in a cask… a patient tale.
text.yamazaki_bI_mist: [warmly] Morning mist does sharpen the senses.
text.yamazaki_bI_sake: [chuckles softly] Not too much this early, if you please.
text.a01: [proud] Welcome. Tonight's a full moon: a banquet at Azuchi Castle!
text.aI01: [warmly] Welcome, honoured guest. A full moon tonight, and a banquet at Azuchi Castle.
text.a02: [warmly] Feasted like this by Lord Nobunaga, I am a lucky man.
text.a03: [curious] Guest, can you hold your drink?
text.aI02: [curious] Can you hold your drink, honoured guest?
text.a04: [proud] Look at these gold screens. The keep has seven storeys, gold and vermilion inside.
text.aI03: [softly] These gold screens, the seven-storey keep… Lord Nobunaga's castle is splendid.
text.a05: [softly] Even the missionaries from the South say they've never seen such a castle.
text.a06: [whispers] …Is the night wind cold? Stay by me and you won't be.
text.aI04: [whispers] …The night wind is cold. Come, stay by me.

text.aI05: [curious] In your time, does Azuchi Castle still stand?

text.a09: [proud] Once the realm is at peace, I'll set sail.

text.a11: [whispers] …Will you come aboard? On my ship?
text.aI07: [whispers] …Would you board that ship too, honoured guest?

text.aN01: [playful] The night is cold. Here, I'll bring the brazier closer.
text.a13: [laughs] Ha ha ha! Takechiyo is thoughtful. Come, drain your cup!

text.aI09: [softly] On a full-moon night, one speaks a wish aloud.
text.a16: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, when my lord says that, he means it.
text.aI10: [whispers] …Tell me one wish of yours, honoured guest.
text.a18: [warmly] The moon is sinking. It was a truly fine banquet.
text.a19: [whispers] …That wish: I'll grant it once the realm is mine.
text.azuchi_bN_dream: [excited] Talk of lands across the sea! It stirs my blood.
text.azuchi_bN_sake: [laughs] That's it, drink up! Tonight we feast!
text.azuchi_bI_dream: [serious] My lord's dreams have no end.
text.azuchi_bI_sake: [chuckles softly] Ho ho, the cups keep emptying.
